title: Satriya Utsavar Parichoy Aru Tatparyya: Sacred Monastic & Riverine Festivals of Assam
author: Dr. Pitambar Dev Goswami (Aauniati Satradhikar)
genre: Cultural History, Monastic Rites & Comparative Ritual Studies
description: Exhaustive cultural treatise by the reverend Satradhikar of Sri Sri Aauniati Satra, Majuli, Dr. Pitambar Dev Goswami. It examines the historical evolution, philosophical significance, and seasonal calendar of sacred Assamese monastic festivals (Palnam, Janmashtami, Raas Leela, Bihu rituals), alongside historical royal patronages granted by Tai-Ahom Swargadeos to the Satras.
